How to bring KOMIS into IPEX/CBF

Name

Discussion ongoing to be able to use Bitbucket as first step for KOMPIS platform on CBF procure tool chain

  • Jira
  • Confluence
  • Bitbucket
  • Bitbucket pipelines

What actions should we start with?

We need to align with the tool investigation being performed, 

https://service.projectplace.com/pp/pp.cgi/r1641685697

"The idea is to collect all the used tooling, find the common ones and decide how to consolidate the usage to avoid duplication, additional costs, etc. For the specific ones we will also discuss and agree on an approach on how they should be managed and procured (if not for free)."

Things that we can identify need investigation already now:

  • Github to Jira integration (We could use VIDGA to test this)
  • Test if Azure Artifacts fulfill our needs as artifact repository
  • Jenkins to Azure pipelines (We could use KOMPIS to test this)
  • Define core tool chain to support DevOps

A list of IPEX non functional requirements that can be applied to all projects at startup. Can be security and performance requirements

How can this be implemented, Jira?
